name: Guizhou Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Based in Guiyang, China, Guizhou Gas Group Corporation Ltd. is a prominent Chinese enterprise in the gas sector. Since its founding in 1995, the company has been responsible for the construction, supply, and management of various critical gas facilities. These facilities include natural gas pipelines, urban gas transmission and distribution networks, liquefied natural gas (LNG) reception and storage stations, and gas fueling stations.
